**Implementation note:** HRP only; equal risk contribution is not built.

## Description

Weight assets so each contributes a similar amount of estimated portfolio risk, often using leverage to reach a target risk.

## Where it may fit

Diversified multi-asset portfolios seeking balance across risk sources instead of dollars invested.

## Vehicles

Risk-parity funds, balanced portfolios and institutional asset allocation.

## Required data

Volatility and covariance estimates, asset universe, correlations, financing/margin costs and risk target.

## Caveats

Asset-class risk contributions can change suddenly; leveraged bond exposure and financing costs are important.
